svg.title: STC-06 · Eighteen passes make one frame.
svg.desc: The Stagehand reel render pipeline in order: scene draw, fx and sheen, persistence, foreground parallax, depth of field, focus pull, bloom, halo, light rays, lens dirt, grade, chroma, grain, tilt-shift, overlays, transition, letterbox and beat chips, with the level gates on each pass. Below: the scene API, the quality governor and the zero-request build.
svg.text: REF STC V1.0 / REEL V6 · FIG STC-06
The reel's film pipeline in render order, with what each intensity level turns down.
RENDER ORDER · ONE FRAME · T = FULL, B = BOARDROOM
PASSES 01 AND 02 RUN IN CAMERA SPACE · 15 TO 18 STAY CRISP ABOVE THE FILM LOOK
draw(s, t, B, dt) { /* one frame */ }
B = { i, t, d, p } s.lvl: 0 FULL, 1 T, 2 B
Device pixel ratio capped at 1.5; canvas capped at 1600 px wide.
Frame time is averaged. Above 26 ms the render scale drops to
82%, floor 50%; under 18 ms it climbs back.
Grade, chroma and lens dirt run only at render scale .75 or better.
One self-contained HTML file, about 1 MB.
Fonts inlined as subset woff2. No CDN, no font links, no analytics.
Every number on screen is a placeholder labeled SAMPLE.
BHIL · STAGEHAND THEME CODEX · FIG STC-06
